newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North tops turnover on div trading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North tops turnover on div trading.

text.p: Shares in mining and forestry group North Ltd topped turnover lists on Monday, as two separate brokers each put a line of about eight million shares through the market.

Brokers said the trade represented investors who were selling North shares as they did not want to receive the dividend for tax reasons, but would later buy back North shares on an ex-dividend status.
A trader said stockbroker Ord Minnett was responsible for one line, while the other was handled by County Natwest.
At 1.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), North shares were one cent lower at A$3.59 on turnover of 16.07 million.
North shares are currently at ex-dividend status. Its final dividend of nine cents a share is due to be paid on September 30.
